entities.summary: Roger Henri Kamiel, Knight Raveel was a Belgian painter, whose work is often associated with pop art because of its depiction of everyday objects. Raveel's style evolved throughout his career, from abstract to figurative. Roger Raveel was a painters & sculptors from Machelen (1921-07-15, Machelen–2013-01-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
